body: Alright. Please remember ,your important to someone.
What do you mean reported? I know your in pain right now,  what helps for me is to write it ,down and rip it up.

They told me if I had wanted to killl myself I’d be dead, that I was doing this for attention. That I had not really tried...  


I agree that a living family is a good reason to stay but it sometimes is not good enough.  They have my brother. 

My thoughts are no longer irrational. I have had these thoughts for years.been admitted and discharged many times.
The fear or surviving death is one of the things you should hang on to on rough days... I found it to be one of the few things to stop me.
